Located in Northeastern Missouri, along the Mississippi River
WELCOME TO PIKE COUNTY
Pike County is located in northeast Missouri and is home to 18,316 citizens. Our economic base is comprised of productive farming and agricultural businesses, manufacturing companies along with many retail businesses.
Pike County is known for our wide range of recreational activities including fishing, hunting, boating & swimming.
We offer beautiful scenic areas such as the Lay Center and
Hwy 79 known as Missouri's "Scenic Byway".
If you are looking for a growing community with a family friendly atmosphere to relocate, start a business or just come for a visit Pike County, MO could be for you.
